summary: Ignore landed standard adoptions in atomic adoption gate on clean heads

delivery.outcome: Prevent historical already-landed standardAdoption tickets from triggering false GOV-SYNC-001 errors in atomic_standard_adoption_paths on clean or scheduled checkouts while retaining verification when an adoption ticket's own carriers are in changed paths or when an adoption has not landed.
nonGoals: No weakening of check_lock or unlanded atomic adoption validation
No version bump, tag, changelog, or consumer repository edits in this slice

architecture.decision: Extract unlanded_standard_adoption_records(root, active, changed) and share it between resolve_validation_base and atomic_standard_adoption_paths. Exclude a standardAdoption ticket only when its own carrier prefix is absent from changed and delivery_landed confirms delivery on refs/remotes/origin/<targetBranch>; keep post-merge range checks (where project/ticket-NNN/** is in changed) and all unlanded adoptions fail-closed. Synchronize the bundled wellman copy byte-for-byte.
interfaceChanges: scripts/governance_check.py: exclude already-landed untouched standardAdoption records in atomic_standard_adoption_paths
architecture.rollback: Reviewed revert of scripts/governance_check.py, bundled copy, and regression tests.

validation.evidence: Single and multiple landed standardAdoption tickets on a clean published checkout return set() and zero GOV-SYNC-001 findings in atomic_standard_adoption_paths, while unlanded adoptions and post-merge diffs touching the adoption ticket directory remain enforced.
Bundled wellman governance_check.py matches scripts/governance_check.py byte-for-byte and native hub checks plus CI/Validator review pass before merge.
